about.appText1: BookFinder is a web application for searching and discovering books using the Open Library API — a free, open catalog of millions of titles from around the world.
about.appText2: You can search and instantly browse results from one of the largest digital libraries available.
about.authorText1: Hi, I am Alla — a frontend developer currently leveling up through the RS School React Course.
about.authorText2: This project was built as part of the course curriculum to practice real-world React development: working with external APIs, client-side routing, TypeScript, and modern tooling.
